## 简介![苹果汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/8eab9e791759330c7343a38914edfb7b96a59342.png) ![辣椒植株](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/14c2753a6ddf163e121cdcd2cf5ab65ba63d639f.png)![糖苹果](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/9db2d9c50a1592789322f8b08a665361bc81a61f.png)![胡萝卜汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/877f969cfe414b1e4fcdf97ec0a2f708ef186dba.png)![香茅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/44abb1f5634afad7bb0fe59366cce079b79b77d6.png)![香辣鸡肉](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/a8ede3dce5ce485c7aad61916cf25e73e9362b79.png)![甜浆果汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/edd9e68e31c750afddb34ab6695e11fb959e1474.png)![布朗尼](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/11047b20068c5c9e4a762faa78a66feba45169fe.png)![兔肉汤](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/7f20ca794d98d71af3d91eb783595c0db6ed86b5.png)![西瓜汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/67ee446781cb3e0c3c3f064716bc8bb3833b9d6a.png)

通过引入丰富多样的新食物、饮料和植物，扩展了游戏中的烹饪体验。玩家可以发现、种植并食用这些物品。本模组提供了独特且异域风情的物品，非常适合喜欢农耕与烹饪的玩家。



| 新增餐点               |   
|---------------------|   
| 骨汤          |   
| 鸡汤       |  
| 南瓜汤        | 
| 香辣鸡肉       |
| 辣椒黄油面包  |
| 玉米面包          |
| 香辣鸡肉       |
| 兔肉汤       |
| 烤玉米       |
| 黄油玉米       |
